Status.note: The Adair County supervisors minutes of March 18, 2026 say a MidAmerican representative reported that construction of the Orient Energy Center will begin soon, with crews onsite the next week and paving in April. That points to construction starting in spring 2026. Only one source says so, and I found no later report confirming it.

qa.recommendation: The MidAmerican fact sheet says the project has three turbines, 700 MW and a unit 3 in service in spring 2029. The company's news release, a business news article and local press say two turbines and 465 MW. GEM has two units of 232.5 MW. Keep two units unless a commission filing shows a third.
qa.note: The fact sheet appears to carry text from an earlier larger design. Local press also cited up to 520 MW.

qa.recommendation: The IRP study lists 233 MW peaking plants in 2028 and 2029. The first two turbines here already add up to about 465 MW. No separate placeholder looks needed for them.
qa.note: The study table shows 233 MW in each of 2028 and 2029. These match the two Orient turbines.
